source.title: 11. Chronic Kidney Disease and Risk Management: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026

schema_gaps: No dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind; guideline recommendations are represented as author_conclusion with descriptive tags.

The quantitative-result model is oriented toward primary studies; secondary narrative ranges, surrogate changes, and comparisons without a clean single effect estimate are preserved as other/limitation atoms rather than forcing artificial quantitative structure.
limitations: Cited primary studies were not independently read in this pass; secondary-reported results remain anchored to dc26s011.pdf.
The full ADA guideline-development methodology and evidence-grade definitions are delegated to Introduction and Methodology and are not contained in dc26s011.pdf.

The governing project file summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md has an internal heading that still identifies Integrated Compact v3; project filename/precedence was followed and the mismatch is recorded.
